cases.name: post-applicable-date-75m-ceiling
cases.description: An issuance after the July 4, 2025 applicable date with $60,000,000 of aggregate gross assets: the $75,000,000 ceiling from P.L. 119-21 applies and the gross-assets condition is met, while the overall verdict stays needs_review (the active-business test is never computable).
cases.source: 26 U.S.C. § 1202(d)(1) including the P.L. 119-21 (2025) amendments (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/1202, verified 2026-10-01)

cases.name: applicable-date-boundary-50m-ceiling
cases.description: The same $60,000,000 of gross assets on the applicable date itself (2025-07-04, not after it): the classic $50,000,000 ceiling applies and the checklist reports not-met.
cases.source: 26 U.S.C. § 1202(d)(1) including the P.L. 119-21 (2025) amendments (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/1202, verified 2026-10-01)
